王野和孙叔两人出了鸽子市一路回到招待所，两人分别躺在床上王野：“孙叔，明天有什么事儿吗？”

孙叔想了一下：“咱俩没什么事儿，那俩调度员要去工厂抽检，估计够他们忙活一天。”

王野直截了当的说道：“孙叔，那我明天不跟着你们了，明天我就出门了，这次来东北我还有别的事情。”

孙叔点点头道：“嗯，科长来之前跟我说过了，小野我还得嘱咐你几句，这边不比四九城，人生地不熟的，一定不要和人起冲突。我知道你手上功夫不错，但是双拳难敌四手。”

王野感激的看着孙叔：“谢谢孙叔了，我知道了，你也放心吧，我就是去周边的村里逛逛。”

孙叔满意的点点头继续说：“还有就是不要进山，这时候山里人多，抬参的，打猎的，最主要的是还有胡子。”

王野疑惑的问道：“孙叔，不是说胡子都被消灭了吗？”

孙叔解释道：“大规模的都被剿灭了，但是总有些漏网之鱼，我来这边好几次了，总是听说有人被胡子杀害了。这种事儿年年都有，到底是真胡子还是有人装神弄鬼谁知道呢。总之安全第一。”

王野真的挺感激孙叔的，对于同事而言跟他嘱咐这么多已经太难得了。这也许就是这个时代人们最难的可贵的朴实性格吧，在后世同事之间不背后捅刀子就算是好同事了。

王野又问了一些本地的注意事项就入睡了，坐了两天多的火车，又去了一趟鸽子市，王野早就累的够呛了，好容易能睡个安稳觉。这一睡就到了第二天早上九点，王野缓缓睁开眼睛，看见旁边床上的孙叔已经出去了。

在孙叔的床上留了一张小纸条上面写着：小野，我陪着调度员去工厂了，你醒后直接退房就行。

王野在房间了，把昨天晚上留在外面换的东西，长枪，和竹箱收进空间。只留下一个背包，轻车简行的出了招待所，这也就是现在的招待所没有监控，要是在后世王野还真不敢在陌生的酒店里使用空间。

王野一出门感觉着这里的气温比四九城要低一些，深深吸了口新鲜的空气，突然王野愣住了：“擦，忘事儿了，城里现在的温度都比四九城温度低，都能感觉到丝丝凉意，这要是进山了不得冻感冒了呀”。

九月份的长白山温度最低只有五六度，这下把王野难住了，想去买衣服都不行。因为买衣服得用布票，王野空间里的布票还是够用的，可是这玩意儿有地区限制，只能在四九城使用。

这人生地不熟的去哪儿找本地布票啊，王野一阵后悔昨天晚上没有换点儿本地票据。没办法只能今天晚上再去一趟鸽子市了。

王野溜溜达达的在这座陌生的城市闲逛，走着走着王野看到了一个门头引起了他的注意：委托行。这里可是能买二手物品的，王野现在急需的是一件交通工具，这要是走着去乡下他这几天什么都不用干了。

进了委托行，看着琳琅满目的二手物品真是大开眼界，这里的东西种类太多了，生活用品，工具材料，也有一些书籍乐器之类的文娱用品，可能这里不是大城市的原因并没有什么贵重物品。

Wang Ye and Uncle Sun left the pigeon market and returned to the guest house. They were lying on the bed respectively. Wang Ye said, "Uncle Sun, what can I do tomorrow?"

Uncle Sun thought for a moment: "We have nothing to do. The two dispatchers are going to the factory for random inspections, which will probably keep them busy for a day."

Wang Ye said bluntly: "Uncle Sun, then I won't follow you tomorrow. I will go out tomorrow. I have other things to do when I come to the Northeast this time."

Uncle Sun nodded and said: "Well, the section chief told me before he came here. Xiaoye, I have to tell you a few words. This place is no better than Sijiu City. If you are not familiar with the place, you must not conflict with others. I know that you are good at martial arts, but it is difficult to beat four hands with two fists."

Wang Ye looked at Uncle Sun gratefully: "Thank you, Uncle Sun. I understand. Don't worry. I'm just going to visit the surrounding villages."

Uncle Sun nodded with satisfaction and continued: "The other thing is don't go into the mountains. There are many people in the mountains at this time, including ginseng lifters, hunters, and most importantly, beards."

Wang Ye asked doubtfully: "Uncle Sun, didn't you say that all the beards were wiped out?"

Uncle Sun explained: "The large-scale ones have been wiped out, but there are always some fish that slip through the net. I have been here several times, and I always hear that someone was killed by a beard. This kind of thing happens every year. Who knows whether it is a real beard or someone who is pretending to be a ghost. In short, safety first."

Wang Ye was really grateful to Uncle Sun. It was very rare for a colleague to give him so many instructions.This may be the most valuable and simple character of people in this era. In future generations, colleagues will be considered good colleagues if they do not stab each other in the back.

Wang Ye asked some more local precautions before falling asleep. After riding the train for more than two days and going to the pigeon market, Wang Ye was already exhausted and could finally sleep peacefully.After sleeping until nine o'clock the next morning, Wang Ye slowly opened his eyes and saw that Uncle Sun on the bed next to him had gone out.

A small note was left on Uncle Sun's bed which read: Xiaoye, I accompanied the dispatcher to the factory. You can just check out when you wake up.

Wang Ye was in the room, putting the things he had left outside last night, including the spear and bamboo box, into the space.Leaving only a backpack behind, he drove out of the guest house simply. This means that the current guest house has no surveillance. In the future, Wang Ye would really not dare to use the space in a strange hotel.

As soon as Wang Ye went out, he felt that the temperature here was lower than that of Sijiu City. He took a deep breath of fresh air. Suddenly Wang Ye was stunned: "Oh, I forgot about things. The temperature in the city is lower than that of Sijiu City now. You can feel the slightest chill. If you go into the mountains, you won't catch a cold."

The temperature in Changbai Mountain in September was as low as five or six degrees Celsius. Wang Ye was stumped and couldn't even think of buying clothes.Because you need to use cloth tickets to buy clothes, the cloth tickets in Wang Ye's space are still enough, but this thing has regional restrictions and can only be used in Sijiu City.

Where could this unfamiliar person go to find local tickets? Wang Ye regretted for a moment that he had not exchanged some local tickets last night.I have no choice but to go to Pigeon Market again tonight.

Wang Ye wandered around this strange city. As he walked, Wang Ye saw a door that caught his attention: the Commission Bank.You can buy second-hand items here. What Wang Ye urgently needs now is a means of transportation. If he walks to the countryside, he won't have to do anything these days.

Entering the commission store, it was eye-opening to see the dazzling array of second-hand items. There are so many types of things here, including daily necessities, tools and materials, and some entertainment items such as books and musical instruments. Maybe because this is not a big city, there are no valuables.
